adopt.missing_manifest: scan sorted immediate children for .git; record origin URL + branch (null when detached); warn-skip origin-less and symlinks; never rewire clones to bare cache

branch_apply:
explicit targets only; checkout existing local branch, else tracking branch from origin/
, else local branch from clean HEAD

parallelism.cap: 2 * os.cpu_count() (per call; clamped with stderr warning)
